sentence: This project studies how cells, circuits and behavior control waking up, called emergence, from general anesthesia.
This project studies how joint inflammation, obesity and muscle mass affect pain and structural changes in knee osteoarthritis.
This project tries to find out how stem cells in the airway lead to squamous and mucous metaplasia after injury.
This project builds a rapid genomic diagnostic platform at the point of care, using the newborn intensive care unit as a laboratory.
This project studies why some photoreceptor cells die while others survive in mouse models of retinal degeneration.
This project builds a software platform that makes computational data analysis easier for cancer researchers.
This project focuses on genetics, genomics and molecular biology through dissertation research.
This project studies how the brain learns from interactions with others, to better understand antisociality and narcissism.
This project manages and analyzes data from a long-term human study of the airway epithelium and respiratory syncytial virus in childhood asthma.
This project uses gene editing to build human models of two syndromes with epileptic seizures and studies how neuronal function goes wrong.
This project studies a hierarchy of stromal progenitor cells in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
This project examines atherosclerotic lesions using histological staining and immunohistochemistry, plus bioinformatics analysis.
This project studies how a reader of modified mRNA drives melanoma metastasis and tests small-molecule inhibitors as treatment.
This project supports a cancer center that links laboratory, clinic and community work to reduce the burden of cancer.
This project tests whether an oncolytic adenovirus combined with natural killer cells can treat recurrent glioblastoma.
This project studies basic mechanisms of cancer gene expression, signaling and immune reprogramming.
This project builds an animal model of fentanyl-induced sudden death to find out its causes and a way to counter it.
This project uses microscopy to study how the cytoskeleton of endothelial cells rearranges and controls the barrier.
This project studies how abnormal DNA methylation is established and interpreted in cancer cells.
This project studies how the hippocampus and medial prefrontal cortex help the brain store long-term memories.
